outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of genomic organization, not a plot of quantitative data.
Panel B shows a scatter/bar plot of inhibition zone % with mean ± SEM, and individual biological replicate values are shown as gray dots overlaid on the mean bars, as stated in the caption.
Same plot type as panel B (Cd condition), with individual gray dots shown alongside the mean ± SEM.
Same plot type as panel B (Cu condition), with individual gray dots shown alongside the mean ± SEM.

Panel E is a line/growth-curve plot (McFarland units over days) showing mean ± SEM; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying points would clutter the time-course data.
Panel F is a line/growth-curve plot showing mean ± SEM over time; line plots are exempt from this check.
Panel G is a line/growth-curve plot showing mean ± SEM over time; line plots are exempt from this check.
